name: BUCK EUCHRE
description: Buck Euchre is a cutthroat (non-partnership) version of Euchre for 4-6 players. Each player plays entirely for themselves. Unlike standard Euchre's fixed 4-player partnerships, Buck Euchre is a standalone player-vs-all game. The dealer selects trump by flipping the top card of the kitty, and each player may order up or pass. The player who orders wins or loses alone based on how many tricks they take.

content.text: Buck Euchre is a cutthroat (non-partnership) version of Euchre for 4-6 players. Each player plays entirely for themselves. Unlike standard Euchre's fixed 4-player partnerships, Buck Euchre is a standalone player-vs-all game. The dealer selects trump by flipping the top card of the kitty, and each player may order up or pass. The player who orders wins or loses alone based on how many tricks they take.
Buck Euchre is an American variant of standard 4-player Euchre, adapted for larger groups where partnership play is impractical. It is particularly popular in the American Midwest.
Four players, each for themselves; some groups extend to 5-6 players by adding extra low cards as described in Dirty Clubs variants.
24 cards (A, K, Q, J, 10, 9 of each French suit) for the core four-player Buck Euchre game; groups that add players can extend the pack with extra low cards such as eights and sevens.
5 cards each. Remaining cards form a kitty; top card turned face-up to propose trump.

items.text: Dirty Clubs: Dirty Clubs is a related variant in which players bid for the right to name trumps (or no trumps), clubs can be called as trump even when not turned, and extra low cards are added when more than four players sit down.
